\begin{example} \end{example}[A general doubly warped circle submersion]

Source: petersen:page-0043, petersen:page-0044 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-submersion ↗ def:pet-ch1-doubly-warped

1. ch1:1.4.11The map \[ (t,e^{i\theta _1},e^{i\theta _2}) \longmapsto (t,e^{i(\theta _1-\theta _2)}) \] is a Riemannian submersion from $dt^2+\rho ^2d\theta _1^2+\phi ^2d\theta _2^2$ to \[ dr^2+\frac{(\rho \phi )^2}{\rho ^2+\phi ^2}d\theta ^2. \] \end{example}
